title: Unnamed insider on a UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, with an NRO badge and Q clearance
place_text: Nevada Test and Training Range, Tonopah Test Range, Nevada

tellings.quote: Uh, one of whom specifically has claimed to have operated on a crash retrieval team, UFO crash retrieval team out of the Nevada Test and Training Range.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says, on Jesse Michels' podcast, that one of his sources claims to have served on a team that recovers crashed UFOs, working out of the Nevada Test and Training Range, a huge military testing area in Nevada. According to UAPGerb, this person held a badge from the National Reconnaissance Office, the US agency that runs spy satellites, and a Q clearance, a top-level security clearance for nuclear secrets. If true, it would mean the US government has a working unit that retrieves non-human craft.
